title: Reply: hard places exist — but saving faith does not require piercing every obscurity
source_text: XLI. Respondeo in Scripturis esse quidem loca quaedam valde difficilia, & super quorum intellectu mens haeret: Nec satis liquido perspicere possunt, etiam doctissimi quis sit verus eorum sensus. Sed inde non sequitur necessariam esse traditionem aliquam unde petatur istorum locorum intelligentia. Nec enim necesse est ad fidem & salutem in verum sensum ejusmodi locorum penetrare. Quod si necessarium esset, Ecclesia quibusdam necessariis careret. Nam, ex confessione ipsorum adversariorum, in obscurissimis istis & perplexis Scripturae locis traditio non docet, & extra dubium ponit quis sit eorum sensus genuinus: ac de illo non minus incerti sunt Doctores Pontificii quam nostri.
pass_a_gloss: I answer that there are indeed in the Scriptures certain places very difficult, and over whose understanding the mind sticks: Nor can even the most learned sufficiently clearly perceive what is their true sense. But thence it does not follow that some tradition is necessary whence the understanding of those places is to be sought. For it is not necessary to faith and salvation to penetrate into the true sense of such places. Which if it were necessary, the Church would lack certain necessities. For, by the confession of the adversaries themselves, in those most obscure and perplexed places of Scripture tradition does not teach, and put beyond doubt, what is their genuine sense: and concerning that the Pontifician Doctors are not less uncertain than ours.
pass_b_english: Yes, Scripture has very hard places even the learned cannot settle.
That does not make an unwritten tradition necessary for those loci.
Faith and salvation do not require piercing every obscurity.
If they did, the Church would lack necessities — and Rome itself confesses tradition does not settle those darkest places either.

choices.term: nec necesse est ad fidem & salutem
choices.english: it is not necessary to faith and salvation
rejected: every hard verse is savingly necessary

choices.why: Their own gap on the darkest loci.
